description:
Run `jit recover`'s lease eviction and stale-lease reclaim through the held lease lock, so recovery changes leases the same way every other operation does.

## Background

`jit recover` (`crates/jit/src/commands/claim.rs:700-750`) cleans stale locks, verifies and rebuilds the index from the log, then evicts expired leases by hand (`load_claims_index`, `evict_expired`, `write_index_atomic` at `:743-748`). The recovery reclaim change 5b37a806 adds a pass that reclaims indefinite leases whose heartbeat lapsed. `ClaimCoordinator::lock()` returns a `LeaseLock` with `list` and `apply`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `jit recover` evicts expired leases and reclaims stale indefinite leases under one `LeaseLock`, through `list()` and `apply`, and reports both counts.
- [hard] REQ-02: Recovery's existing tests pass, and a test shows that an expired lease and a stale indefinite lease are both removed and logged once.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
title: Recovery evicts and reclaims leases through the lease lock
